description: This file defines types and functions for parsing, compiling, matching, and expanding path patterns used in secret target registry entries, including handling wildcards, arrays, and path tokenization.

methods.name: countDynamicPatternTokens
methods.description: Counts the number of wildcard or array tokens in a list of path pattern tokens.

methods.name: parsePathPattern
methods.description: Parses a dot-separated path pattern string into an array of path pattern tokens.

methods.name: compileTargetRegistryEntry
methods.description: Compiles a secret target registry entry into a form with parsed path tokens and counts, validating refPathPattern if secretShape is 'sibling_ref'.

methods.name: matchPathTokens
methods.description: Matches a list of segments against path pattern tokens, returning captures if matched.

methods.name: materializePathTokens
methods.description: Reconstructs path segments from tokens and captures.

methods.name: expandPathTokens
methods.description: Recursively expands a node structure into all possible path matches based on path pattern tokens.
